method: Independent evidence-based reviews, parent code cross-checks, focused reproduction tests, and parent browser verification. Findings required concrete triggers and fixes before implementation.

implemented.finding: Controlled visual fields dropped trailing spaces and whitespace-only edits
implemented.evidence: Parser trimming and reproduced typing tests; parent browser kept 'Alex ' then 'Alex Morgan'

implemented.finding: Multiline edits could disappear from formatted fields
implemented.evidence: Source span/parser reproductions and multiline regressions

implemented.finding: Repeated section names merged distinct sections
implemented.evidence: Title-only grouping; parent browser confirmed two independent Skills sections after fix

implemented.finding: Unknown/code environments exposed raw contents and could confuse insertion boundaries
implemented.evidence: Listing/verbatim/minted/custom environment reproduction tests, including literal document/list endings preserved during insertion

implemented.finding: Windows CRLF lines added blank lines to fields and hid the headline
implemented.evidence: Full LF/CRLF projection equality and exact span patch tests; parent browser confirmed restored headline and no extra textarea scrollbars

implemented.finding: Manual guest PDF preview reset the AI review baseline and could allow overwriting newer edits
implemented.evidence: runCompile wrote the shared baseline for normal compile; now only rewrite submission captures it

implemented.finding: Completed AI PDFs could be treated as current documents before approval
implemented.evidence: PDF loading/export paths read raw rewrite stream results; approved selection policy and guest source guard added

implemented.finding: Discarded failed AI output remained available through Apply anyway
implemented.evidence: Discard cleared baseline while stream retained candidate; discarded job now cleared

implemented.finding: AI trim did not capture its own review baseline
implemented.evidence: Compared trim and ordinary optimization call paths; trim now captures baseline and owner identity

implemented.finding: Closing a pending document-assistant request left loading stuck after reopening
implemented.evidence: Request invalidation skipped old finally cleanup; close now clears loading

implemented.finding: Busy auto-preview could drop edits, while manual preview could duplicate submissions
implemented.evidence: Baseline advanced before busy submission guard and manual acceptance did not settle it; queued edit acknowledgement and captured submission baselines revised

implemented.finding: Active contrast toggle foreground classes conflicted
implemented.evidence: Actual Tailwind cascade test plus settled parent browser black-on-yellow colors

implemented.finding: Destructive labels lacked contrast in dark palettes
implemented.evidence: Actual generated utility/palette contrast tests; semantic err-fg token added

implemented.finding: Mobile guest editor had no reachable appearance controls
implemented.evidence: Header controls hidden below sm and global header excluded; controls added to mobile tools pane

implemented.finding: Visual section navigation ignored reduced-motion preference
implemented.evidence: Explicit smooth API option; navigation now selects auto when requested

implemented.finding: Public guest CTAs could reopen saved Source mode
implemented.evidence: Header URL plus initialization path; explicit visual query added
Gallery use handler redirects guests to login; marketing copy corrected

implemented.finding: Hardcoded marketing origins conflicted with configurable discovery URLs
Illustrative rewrites introduced facts absent from their original examples
implemented.evidence: Before/after text comparison; originals now contain all rewritten facts

not_implemented.reason: Plausible crowding risk, but no observed collision or viewport evidence. Avoided speculative layout change.

not_implemented.suggestion: Further contrast CSS change based on orange/intermediate runtime colors
not_implemented.reason: Parent cross-check showed a 150ms transition, followed by correct settled black/yellow. No extra fix needed.

not_implemented.suggestion: Question advertised priority processing or AI-key support
not_implemented.reason: Reviewer found actual worker priorities and plan/provider implementation supporting the claims.

not_implemented.suggestion: Broaden this pass to legacy Updates animations
not_implemented.reason: Separate optional enhancement; not a confirmed regression from current changes.

verification.browser: whitespace, multiline, duplicate sections, CRLF, contrast, visual exports, entry links, and favicon metadata checked

limits: Local backend/database still prevent live AI/PDF and authenticated end-to-end verification
Asynchronous preview and assistant request fixes are code-flow verified, not live end-to-end verified
Mobile viewport behavior remains unverified in the available in-app browser
Some custom template styled headers, links, and complex layouts remain outside conservative visual projection; source is preserved and the UI discloses this
No ranking or conversion improvement is claimed
